Resolves #18633

🌿 A `$`-prefixed name used to slip into a saved collection through the one write path that had no library instance to refuse it; now there is no path on which a stored record can take the name a declared perspective owns.

The reservation rule from #18609 — `$`-prefixed names are the engine's; a saved record may equal a declared perspective but never define or impersonate one — sat only on the instance libraries' write boundary (`savePerspective`, `renamePerspective`, `TopologyLibrary#save`). The static helpers were a second boundary it never reached: `PerspectiveLibrary.createSavedLayoutCollection` and `upsertSavedLayout` installed a `$default` layout, `Persistence.createTopologyCollection` accepted a `$default` topology, and the Neural Link's `DockService.storeTopology` writes every topology capture through the latter. The prefix rule now lives inside both collection validators — `validateSavedLayoutCollection` and `validateTopologyCollection` — so the factories, the static upsert and a borrowed read refuse alike, with the instance path's exact error; the declared-name refusal stays instance-only, since a static helper cannot know the workspace's declared set. Two docblocks say which rule applies where.

Evidence: L2 (pure data-plane helpers; every AC is unit-observable in the engine tier) → L2 required. Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `DockZoneModel.spec.mjs` › "an engine-reserved layoutId or perspectiveName refuses at the saved-layout factory and on the static upsert …": `createSavedLayoutCollection` returns `collection: null`; `upsertSavedLayout` returns the collection by reference; a hand-built (borrowed) collection carrying a `$default` record fails `validateSavedLayoutCollection` — each with the instance path's exact message, for a `$default` id and a `$snapshot` name; the plain `default` stores |
| AC-2 | `DockZoneModel.spec.mjs` › "keyed topology collection: an engine-reserved id or name refuses at the factory …" and `DockService.spec.mjs` › "capturePerspective (topology) cannot store an engine-reserved name …": the factory returns `collection: null` with the message; the Neural Link capture reports `stored: false` with it and the holder's collection is untouched |
| AC-3 | same two `DockZoneModel.spec.mjs` arms: the raw `capturePerspective` and `captureTopologyPerspective` records for a `$default` name come back with `errors: []` — the collection is the boundary, the record itself stays valid |
| AC-4 | #18609's arms: `DockPerspectiveNameSources.spec.mjs` 7/7 green in the same run; `Refs #18605`, `Resolves` this leaf only |

## Deltas from ticket
The author folded Emmy's intake finding — `createSavedLayoutCollection` is a third static write path — into the body while this was being built, and the rule moved from the upsert into both collection validators as the fold asks. The instance `savePerspective` does not delegate to `upsertSavedLayout`, so the earlier "drops its own prefix line if it delegates" clause does not apply; both paths call `Persistence.reservedNameErrors` and the rule still lives in that one function.

## Test Evidence
- Mutation A (the `validateSavedLayoutCollection` refusal removed): exactly the saved-layout arm red, on the factory's `collection: null` assertion — the first of its reserved assertions; every other arm green.
- Mutation B (the `validateTopologyCollection` consultation of `reservedNameErrors` removed, at 98d2c1617a): exactly the topology factory arm and the Neural Link store arm red, on their `collection: null` / `stored: false` assertions; 180/182.
- Review round 1 (RA-1, P2): the topology validator's own `name.startsWith` branch threw `TypeError` for a truthy non-string alias where the schema check used to answer. It now consults `reservedNameErrors` as one line, the same shape as the saved-layout side — the helper already filters non-strings, so the type assumption lives in one place. Three malformed-alias cases (`42`, `{}`, `true`) sit beside the reserved and plain controls: red on d952a043a3 (`TypeError: name.startsWith is not a function`), green at 98d2c1617a.
- Restored from the commit: 228/228 across `DockZoneModel`, `DockPerspectiveNameSources`, `PerspectiveLibrary`, `TopologyLibrary` and `DockService`.
